description: This file defines the DirectSum class within the Matrix\Operators namespace, implementing an operation to perform direct sum (block diagonal concatenation) of matrices. It provides methods to execute the operation on either a Matrix object or numeric array input, with internal logic to modify the matrix data structure accordingly.

classes.name: DirectSum
classes.description: A class to perform direct sum operations on matrices, supporting chaining and handling both matrix objects and arrays.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the direct sum operation with the provided value, accepting matrices or arrays, and returns the operation object for chaining.

methods.name: directSumMatrix
methods.description: Performs an internal direct sum (block diagonal concatenation) with a Matrix object, updating the internal matrix representation.
